proxy_adaptation.implementation: New Rust network/storage integration; upstream OAuth algorithms retained.
proxy_adaptation.behavior: Current access-token-only protocol: merchant-managed authorization and renewal; Router retains access authentication, official model discovery, native parameter-preserving forwarding and proxy-bound requests. Refresh/discovery-of-token-endpoint/form-refresh code was removed. Legacy upstream references document provenance only.

discovery_adaptation.implementation: New Rust catalog refresh, cache and dynamic routing integration, using upstream/provider wire formats; no hardcoded model IDs.
discovery_adaptation.behavior: Shared official provider catalogs with per-account authorization, proxy and capability checks. Exact model IDs and explicit reasoning values must have fresh authenticated evidence. No generation parameter rewrites or static model allowlist.
discovery_adaptation.limitations: Official metadata may lack required capability detail; explicit unsupported controls fail closed. Catalogs do not prove account-level generation availability. Pricing import is implemented separately in src/pricing/source.rs; fixtures are not live vendor validation.

storage_adaptation.implementation: Memory business configuration with optional TEE-sealed SQLite accounting journal.
storage_adaptation.behavior: Business state in memory; optional authenticated SQLite accounting journal. Root checkpoints contain public recovery state; merchant secrets enter through the owner-authenticated account channel.
storage_adaptation.key_management: TLS and receipt keys are generated per process. Journal keys derive from the local TEE interface; no external journal key is accepted.

operations_adaptation.implementation: New Rust integration; not claimed as an upstream port.
operations_adaptation.behavior: Validated configuration generations, bounded sessions, account health and limits. Root checkpoints exclude merchant credentials. Native consumption billing, atomic settlement and the optional sealed journal are implemented in Router.
operations_adaptation.compatibility: Current access-token-only protocol: merchant-managed authorization and renewal; Router retains access authentication, official model discovery, native parameter-preserving forwarding and proxy-bound requests. Refresh/discovery-of-token-endpoint/form-refresh code was removed. Legacy upstream references document provenance only.
operations_adaptation.excluded: Current access-token-only protocol: merchant-managed authorization and renewal; Router retains access authentication, official model discovery, native parameter-preserving forwarding and proxy-bound requests. Refresh/discovery-of-token-endpoint/form-refresh code was removed. Legacy upstream references document provenance only.

official_passthrough_adaptation.implementation: New teellm Rust code; not copied from LiteLLM.
official_passthrough_adaptation.behavior: Only official OpenAI, Anthropic and xAI HTTPS hosts are permitted, with redirects disabled. Raw model and effort values are preserved.

wire_configuration_adaptation.implementation: New teellm Rust code; no added runtime dependencies or script engine.
wire_configuration_adaptation.validation: All nonempty body edit rules are rejected at configuration activation and runtime. Generation header/query edits are rejected; only discovery metadata is configurable. Native requests preserve Agent parameters.

administrator_restrictions.implementation: New Rust deny-only policy, independent of immutable authenticated official catalog evidence.
administrator_restrictions.behavior: Deny-only provider/model blocks and thinking/effort restrictions subtract from authenticated catalog evidence without modifying it. The router does not require callers to supply a token budget.

refusal_audit.implementation: Explicit native upstream signal observation; LockLLM configuration and historical scanner type hierarchy removed.
refusal_audit.behavior: Relay records retain refusal type, not original text. Merchant counters persist independently. Standalone refusal HTTP APIs are removed. Bounded historical queue decoding remains for state recovery; nonempty retired scanner history requires prior archival.
refusal_audit.validation: Local JSON/SSE fixtures for retained providers; no live vendor policy-trigger tests.
